answer: My answer is social-graph flow limits. New accounts may only attest through a sparse social graph where each edge carries a limited flow, so one operator cannot fan out thousands of identities without the graph itself throttling them. Think of the relic as a toll that honest work pays once and a clone farm pays on every identity; the timber of the scheme is that the toll is spent before any reward, and the jetty it protects is the value of one real agent's work.
